card.statement:
Let $\lambda,\mu\in X_{*}(T)$ with $\lambda$ dominant.
Then the $\mathbf{k}$ -module
$\mathsf{F}_{\mu}\bigl(\mathcal{J}_{!}(\lambda,\mathbf{k})\bigr)$ , resp.  $\mathsf{F}_{\mu}\bigl(\mathcal{J}_{*}(\lambda,\mathbf{k})\bigr)$ ,
is free, with a canonical basis parametrized by the irreducible components of $\mathord{\mathrm{Gr}}_{G}^{\lambda}\cap S_{\mu}$ , resp. of $\mathord{\mathrm{Gr}}_{G}^{\lambda}\cap T_{\mu}$ .
card.label: Proposition 11.1

paper.title: Notes on the geometric Satake equivalence
paper.abstract: These notes are devoted to a detailed exposition of the proof of the Geometric Satake Equivalence for general coefficients, following Mirkovic-Vilonen.
